name: Suzhou Novosense Microelectronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Suzhou Novosense Microelectronics Co., Ltd., founded in 2013 and headquartered in Suzhou, researches, designs and sells analog and mixed-signal integrated circuits. Its products include magnetic, pressure and temperature sensors, signal chain chips such as digital isolators and microcontrollers, and power management devices like gate drivers and motor drivers. They are used in automotive, industrial, communications and consumer electronics, and it offers custom chip design and packaging.
